description: This file defines the ImageResizer class, a subclass of ImageWorker, which provides functionality to resize and decode images from resources, files, or file descriptors to specified dimensions, primarily used for efficiently handling large images in memory-constrained environments.

classes.name: ImageResizer
classes.description: A subclass of ImageWorker that resizes images from resources or files to specified dimensions for efficient memory usage.

methods.name: ImageResizer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes ImageResizer with target width and height.

methods.name: ImageResizer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes ImageResizer with a single size for both width and height.

methods.name: setImageSize
methods.description: Set the target image width and height.

methods.name: setImageSize
methods.description: Set the target image size for both dimensions equally.

methods.name: processBitmap
methods.description: Processes a resource ID into a resized Bitmap.

methods.name: decodeSampledBitmapFromResource
methods.description: Decodes and samples down a Bitmap from resources to the requested dimensions.

methods.name: decodeSampledBitmapFromFile
methods.description: Decodes and samples down a Bitmap from a file path.

methods.name: decodeSampledBitmapFromDescriptor
methods.description: Decodes and samples down a Bitmap from a file descriptor.

methods.name: calculateInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates an optimal inSampleSize value for downsampling bitmaps based on requested dimensions.
